I killed the smugglers at Gideon South Watch and took the Old Silver Setting from their chest. I also have the Collector (Ennodius Vanin) note. The setting has the ship name Pale Harvest inside, a Company freighter sunk in Hatandros Bight with a Gideon dealers whole stock, so the real Eye may lie in that wreck. Unbound agents asked after the glass in Gideon a month ago. Nesh-Deeka paid 100 gold and gave the setting back. I do not know where the Bight is. No next marker.
